about.title: Pilates Instructor
about.bio: I teach Pilates as a system that builds true strength from the inside out — core control, movement precision, and the postural awareness that reduces pain, prevents injury, and makes every other activity feel better. Sessions are always adapted to your body and goals.

hero.headline: Strengthen Your Center. Move With Purpose.

packages.title: Athletic Conditioning Program

packages.title: Private Sessions

faq.question: What's the difference between Pilates and regular core exercise?
faq.answer: Pilates trains the deep stabilizing muscles of the trunk in coordination with breathing and movement — it's more about control and quality than volume or load.

faq.question: Do you use a reformer?
faq.answer: Both mat and reformer Pilates are available. Reformer work allows more movement variation and resistance — great for intermediate and advanced students.

faq.question: Is Pilates appropriate after injury or surgery?
faq.answer: Yes — with clearance from your medical provider, I work with post-rehab clients on careful progressions that rebuild stability and movement confidence.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a local Pilates studio. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: What should I wear?
faq.answer: Form-fitting athletic clothing that allows your instructor to see alignment. Grip socks are recommended. No shoes required.
